organization: Illinois Pollution Control Board via Cornell LII
title: 35 Ill. Adm. Code 201.146 Exemptions from State Permit Requirements
claim: The list of emission units exempt from Illinois air construction/operating permits contains no exemption for crematories; incinerators are expressly carved back into permit requirements (e.g., domestic-use units 'except ... any incinerator')
excerpt: Exemption list excludes incinerators; no crematory exemption found in text search.
limitations: Applicability of 'incinerator' definition to pet retorts must be confirmed with IEPA; text read via LII mirror.

organization: Illinois Pollution Control Board via Cornell LII
title: 35 Ill. Adm. Code 201.175 Registration of Smaller Sources (ROSS)
claim: ROSS lets sources under 5 tpy combined criteria pollutants register annually instead of obtaining permits (new sources register 10 days before construction) but excludes emission units 'used ... as incinerator systems'
excerpt: 'Emission units at the source are not used as thermal desorption systems ... or as incinerator systems.'
limitations: If IEPA classes a pet retort as an incinerator system, ROSS is unavailable and a construction plus operating permit is required.
